title: UniQueR: Unified Query-based Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2603.22851v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present UniQueR, a unified query-based feedforward framework for efficient and accurate 3D reconstruction from unposed images. Existing feedforward models such as DUSt3R, VGGT, and AnySplat typically predict per-pixel point maps or pixel-aligned Gaussians, which remain fundamentally 2.5D and limited to visible surfaces. In contrast, UniQueR formulates reconstruction as a sparse 3D query inference problem. Our model learns a compact set of 3D anchor points that act as explicit geometric queries, enabling the network to infer scene structure, including geometry in occluded regions--in a single forward pass. Each query encodes spatial and appearance priors directly in global 3D space (instead of per-frame camera space) and spawns a set of 3D Gaussians for differentiable rendering. translated_title: UniQueR：基于统一查询的前馈式三维重建
translated_abstract: 我们提出了UniQueR，一个统一的基于查询的前馈框架，用于从未标定姿态的图像中高效且准确地进行三维重建。现有的前馈模型（如DUSt3R、VGGT和AnySplat）通常预测逐像素点图或像素对齐的高斯表示，这些方法在本质上仍是2.5D的，且局限于可见表面。相比之下，UniQueR将重建问题表述为稀疏三维查询推理问题。我们的模型学习一组紧凑的三维锚点，作为显式的几何查询，使网络能够在单次前向传播中推断场景结构——包括被遮挡区域的几何信息。每个查询直接在全局三维空间（而非逐帧相机空间）中编码空间和外观先验，并生成一组用于可微渲染的三维高斯。通过在多视角特征上利用统一的查询交互和解耦的交叉注意力设计，UniQueR实现了强大的几何表达能力。
tldr: UniQueR提出了一种基于稀疏3D查询推理的统一前馈框架，通过学习紧凑的三维锚点作为显式几何查询并直接在全局三维空间中编码先验，实现了从未标定图像中单次前向传播即可重建包含遮挡区域的完整场景结构。
en_tdlr: UniQueR introduces a unified query-based feedforward framework that learns a compact set of 3D anchor points as explicit geometric queries in global 3D space, enabling single-pass reconstruction of complete scenes—including occluded regions—from unposed images.
